headline: Gildan Shares Plunge as Clothing Maker Lowers Full-Year Forecast
summary: Montreal-based clothing maker Gildan saw its shares drop after missing estimates and lowering its full-year forecast due to higher borrowing costs and inflationary pressures.
why: Apparel manufacturers are vulnerable to consumer discretionary spending shifts and rising financing expenses during inflationary economic cycles.

impacts.name: Gildan Activewear Inc.
impacts.why: Gildan missed analyst estimates, cut its full-year forecast, and saw its shares plunge.
